notes: Commit ba915983. Coverage now means navigation (literal goto/gotoDashboardRoute, or a table entry in a spec that navigates with a computed argument, excluding assertion/link contexts); each spec evaluated alone. Heuristic: the table-driven arm is spec-level. In a spec that calls goto/gotoDashboardRoute with any non-literal argument, every quoted route outside assertion/link context counts, without proving it is the table passed to goto; per the lane review recount 73 of 209 pages are covered only through this arm (58 of 97 specs navigate with a computed argument). Follow-up: tie the table arm to the identifier passed to goto. Observability half already on main (tools/scripts/observability-alert-rules.mjs used by validate-observability.mjs:17). ESLint on the .mjs not run: root parser config has no tsconfig for tools/scripts.
